subject: Ethiopia — currency and payment tips
body:
Hi Matthias,

Tips for Addis:
- Bring USD cash (new, unmarked bills preferred)
- Credit cards accepted at Hilton and major hotels only
- Local currency: Ethiopian Birr (ETB), ~130 ETB = €1
- ATMs unreliable — bring enough cash

Let me know if you need anything else.

Sarah

subject: Addis packing tips
body:
Hi Matthias,

Weather forecast for Addis (Nov 15-22):
- Daytime: 22-25°C
- Evening: 10-14°C
- Possible afternoon showers

Pack: light layers, rain jacket, business attire for conference, comfortable shoes. Altitude may cause mild breathlessness initially.

Sarah
